items.text: Self-management skills include planning, time use, emotional control, goal setting and follow-through. Employers often call them ownership or reliability.

items.heading: Run the Weekly Review
items.text: Run the weekly review for four weeks and note completed items. Ask a manager or senior what reliability looks like in your field.
